# Branches a pull request can target that must be covered by a full-gate
# `pull_request:` trigger. One name per line; `#` starts a comment.
#
# This list is the repository's claim about itself. The `ci-trigger-coverage`
# gate reads it together with `.github/workflows` and fails when a branch here
# is not named by a workflow that runs `budlum-gates --all`. A new integration
# branch that is not added here is not silently uplifted - it is simply not
# claimed, and the claim that matters is the one in this file.
#
# Added 2026-11-23: fourteen long-lived integration branches existed while the
# full-gate triggers named eight, none of them these. A PR into any of them ran
# no workflow at all.
main
consensus-of-consensuses
testnet-quantum
testnet
garden
budlum-stack
agg/phase-5-pcs-claims
agg/phase-2-sig-claims
agg/phase-3-recursion-stark

audit-testnet-2026-11

ortak-teslim

# Added 2026-11-27: `testnet-50` has been the base of an open pull request
# (#221, the Garden slice) since 2026-11-25, and the delivery pull request
# #215's head is the same branch. It was not claimed here, so a pull request
# into it was covered by contract by nothing - the trigger list and the tree
# disagreed and only the tree was measured. The stacked-continuation bases above
# are the same shape; this line makes the claim match.
